svg.aria-label: The path so far. 2026 — now: Tech Lead & AI Systems Architect, Ton avenir au maroc, Agadir. Leading the architecture, AI integration and delivery of the TAM Digital Platform. Apr — Jul 2026: Full-Stack Web & Mobile Developer, intern, Larmo, Casablanca. Designed and built StoreezCOD for web and mobile, on a scalable backend. May — Jul 2025: Full-Stack Developer, intern, NJT Group, Marrakech. Built and maintained web applications alongside senior developers. 2024 — 2026: Full-Stack Developer Program, graduated, YouCode, UM6P, Youssoufia. Two intensive, project-based years: from algorithms to deployed full-stack apps. 2023 — 2024: Baccalauréat, Physical Sciences, Arij Almaarifa, Sidi Bibi. A foundation in analytical thinking, before software.
